native_return_guard.scope: Before RTS delay slot when guest PR differs from filter entry; unsupported return transfer, not a hardware-exception model.

native_saved_pointer_guards.scope: Before dereferencing the reloaded saved mesh pointer outside the modeled RAM range; no hardware-exception dispatch.

scope: Native mesh filter, material flags, shader header, texture cache/descriptor lookup and command finalization; original full-state and ordered boundary comparisons with independent mask/cache/culling-result assertions.
limitations: Four lower vertex/filter workers and 22 acquisition/primitive services remain explicit fixtures. No pixels, GPU/MMIO or complete frame-driver proof.
Existing finite scalar and shared vector numerical-oracle limits retained; scalar trap classification uses native probes.
Constructed valid projection, bounds, texture table, headers and command destinations; arbitrary metadata/pointers/hardware exceptions remain outside scope.
Reached saved-mesh-pointer and changed-return-address guards return host status -3 before an unsupported transfer; partial state is compared, not physical Dreamcast fault dispatch.
